title: bc-manifest.json
description: The entries a workflow module offers to a VanillaBP Business Cockpit, and the files they are in.

manifestVersion.description: The version of this format. A cockpit refuses a higher one it does not know.

buildVersion.description: The version of the module's build, shown in a details view, if at all.

buildTimestamp.description: When the module was built, also only for a details view.

entries.description: Entry name to file. The file is relative to the manifest.
